name: Backup Previous LXC Config
description:
Reconfigure/replace safety net: copies the previous container's /etc/pve/lxc/<previous_vm_id>.conf to /var/lib/proxvex/conf-backups/<vm_id>/ before the old container is modified or destroyed.

Only runs when previous_vm_id is set (reconfigure/replace flows). Captures out-of-band pct-config edits that the deploy-params baseline cannot restore. Paired with the check-phase 955-check-conf-diff.json which diffs this backup against the finalized new .conf.
